announcements.title: PETABLOCKS Season 2 & Official Launcher Closed Beta
announcements.summary: Welcome to the official PETABLOCKS Desktop Launcher! Season 2 runs on Minecraft 1.21.1 with Create, Steam 'n' Rails, Aeronautics, FTB Chunks, and automatic modpack updates.
bullets: Link your Discord account from the account menu or with /link in Discord to claim 32x Diamonds and sync your network rank.
Modpack updates show up on the Play tab with one-click release notes.
Found a bug or have a mod suggestion? Use the Feedback tab to send a report directly to the team.

announcements.title: Upcoming Servers: Patreon Testbed & Hunger Games
announcements.summary: The launcher is ready for every server on the PETABLOCKS Minecraft Network:
bullets: PETABLOCKS Season 2 (s2.petablocks.com) — live now in closed beta, public launch in January 2027.
PETABLOCKS Create 2 (create2.petablocks.com) — live and open to everyone.
Patreon Supporter Server (patreon.petablocks.com) — sandbox and early-access testbed for Patreon supporters.
PETABLOCKS Hunger Games (hg.petablocks.com) — custom competitive arena survival arriving Spring 2027.
